open_gaps.est_wall: ~4 h GPU (4 arms x 3 seeds, N=1000, matched total NFE)
open_gaps.gap: Two independent defects make every quoted R5b number unquotable, and they must be fixed in ONE run. (a) Budget: the sweep gave codimension_sheet 150 total NFE and the other three arms 75-79, because each arm's step count is set by its own n_cap and the sweep never applied an equal-total-NFE constraint. The three under-budgeted arms collapse (rho_arm ~ 0.10) and pay +18 to +23% FID - including the +23.13% cosine figure. GAP-55 fixed this for the MNIST driver; the R5b driver was never fixed. (b) Sample size: +52.33% is an N=200 measurement, and GAP-57 calibrated the FID estimator against a known truth (a paired delta whose true value is 11.52 reads 18.99 at n=200 and 12.99 at n=1000), so the magnitude is inflated 40-65%.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) Port the GAP-55 equal-total-NFE constraint to the R5b driver so every arm spends the same total NFE as the baseline. (2) Re-run 4 arms x 3 seeds at N=1000 and that matched budget. (3) Report per-arm delta with the bias-corrected record-level paired interval. (4) Pre-registered reading, written before the run: if the matched-budget N=1000 delta is below +5%, the +18..+23% and +52.33% figures are RETRACTED as artefacts and every audit that quotes them is corrected; if it survives, quote the N=1000 magnitude and retire the N=200 numbers from every headline. (5) No seeds beyond 42/43/44; no re-tuning after the result.
open_gaps.agent_action: 1) Read scripts/wave225_p9_r5b_matched_eff_nfe.py for the existing budget-matching hook before writing anything new. 2) Patch the R5b driver to accept an equal-total-NFE flag. 3) Run 12 cells on cuda:0. 4) Recompute with tools/gap56_r5c_paired_bootstrap.py. 5) Write docs/audit/gap66-r5b-equal-budget.md with the retraction (or confirmation) stated explicitly. 6) 6 gates + commit.
open_gaps.deliverable: One R5b table at matched budget and N=1000, and a retraction or confirmation of the +18..+23% and +52.33% arms.

open_gaps.gap: GAP-45 showed the memory term is null on R1 - the cell where the framework wins on LineageFlow. Whether ANY winning cell is memory-driven is unknown: the R5c boundary win (-9.37% on w16e1_5k, 3 draws, N=1000, CI excluding 0) has never been run with beta != 1/6. If beta=1 reproduces that win, the framework's namesake mechanism has no empirical support anywhere in the paper, and the theory (Thm 4 contraction of the memory map) must be restated as an operating-regime result rather than as the explanation of the gains. That is a positioning decision and it should be made on evidence.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) w16e1_5k, N=1000, NFE=50 total, R=4, --restart-t0-mode memory, --nfe-allocation proportional, --equal-total-nfe, seeds 42/43/44, beta in {0, 1/6, 1}. (2) Record-level paired delta vs baseline per arm with CI, and the beta=1/6 vs beta=1 contrast with CI. (3) Verdict: if beta=1/6 vs beta=1 includes 0, record 'the memory term is null on every measured winning cell' and restate the theory's empirical scope. (4) beta=0 is expected to collapse; if it does NOT collapse on this checkpoint, that is itself a finding about the checkpoint's flow.
open_gaps.agent_action: 1) Verify --beta-framework semantics before running (the driver already accepts it). 2) Run 9 cells on cuda:0. 3) Bootstrap with tools/gap56_r5c_paired_bootstrap.py (bias-corrected interval). 4) Write docs/audit/gap61-memory-attribution.md. 5) 6 gates + commit.
open_gaps.deliverable: A yes/no on whether the memory term earns anything anywhere.

open_gaps.gap: R1's NFE=150 win (+117 hits, +74.1%, per-record CI [+0.073,+0.160]) is the paper's strongest cross-domain positive and the only one on a canonical LineageFlow checkpoint, but it rests on ONE prior draw (seed 42). The N=200 screen covers three seeds (48/55/63 vs baseline 37/36/32, 3/3 positive, 2/3 CI excluding 0) and every N=200 arm is a byte-identical prefix of its N=1000 arm, so three-seed evidence exists but only at screen power. Until seeds 43/44 run at N=1000 the paper has no 3-seed positive on a production checkpoint.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) Seeds 43 and 44 at N=1000, NFE=150, R=3, restart_min_nfe=5, temperature=1.0, beta default (1/6), --start-index 0; recipe otherwise identical to gap55-r1-nfe150-n1000/seed42. (2) Per-seed per-record paired delta vs that seed's own baseline with a 95% bootstrap CI and an exact sign test, then a pooled 3-seed estimate. (3) Report against the R-level alpha 0.00714 (k=7), not 0.05. (4) Verdict: 3/3 CIs excluding 0 -> SUPPORTED (single-checkpoint, single-model); otherwise NOT_SIGNIFICANT with the pooled interval and per-seed spread. (5) No seeds beyond 42/43/44. (6) Do not re-tune beta, R or NFE after seeing the result.
